_purpose: What a model costs to serve, so that serving can be sized without a benchmark of your machine; `mcgyvr setup` and `mcgyvr emit` read it to size the room each unit takes. Each row is a model's facts: its size, its weights and the memory it takes to serve. A memory figure is an estimate, mostly read through another server program with a file of the same model, usually of the same quantisation type; a row's `not_for_fit` says when it is not the model's own footprint. None is a reading of your machine.

models.not_for_fit: its memory figure is the resident part under partial offload, not the file
